preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(4 <= N <= 64 for N in test_cases_N)
preconditions.description: For every test case, the matrix dimension N is between 4 and 64 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(matrix) == N and all(len(row) == N for row in matrix) for matrix, N in zip(test_cases_matrices, test_cases_N))
preconditions.description: Each test case provides an N x N matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(set(val for row in matrix for val in row) == set(range(1, N*N + 1)) for matrix, N in zip(test_cases_matrices, test_cases_N))
preconditions.description: Each matrix contains exactly the integers from 1 to N^2 inclusive.
The sum of N^2 over all test cases does not exceed 3*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer representing the minimum number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == min_ops(test_cases_matrices[i], test_cases_N[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output is the smallest number of operations required to sort the matrix into row-major order, where min_ops(M, N) is the minimum k such that applying k transpose operations on submatrices of size L1, L2, ..., Lk transforms M into the sorted state.
